info.name: OHM Backend API - Root and Tenant
info.description: Requests are grouped by schema. Public / Shared needs no account. Root / Super Admin uses a public-schema token and omits X-Tenant. Tenant Workspace uses a tenant token and X-Tenant: {{tenantSlug}}. Tenant Owner Portal uses a platform-schema tenant-owner token and omits X-Tenant. List endpoints use page=1 and page_size=20 by default; page_size accepts values up to 100. Authentication uses 15-minute access tokens, rotating refresh tokens, and revocable server-side sessions. The Settings folders cover profile, email verification, appearance, notifications, and sessions. Quote requests include GSTIN lookup, form metadata, line discounts/UOM, freight and packing GST, seller tax settings, and filter/search/order examples.

item.name: 01 - ROOT / SUPER ADMIN (public schema)
item.description: Platform control-plane APIs. Use the root/platform login and do not send X-Tenant.

item.name: 00 - Root / platform schema authentication
item.description: Use a platform-schema account. Omit X-Tenant for root/platform APIs and the tenant-owner portal. Login responses save tokens to rootAccessToken/rootRefreshToken.

item.name: Login (password or OTP)
item.description: Unified login endpoint. Authenticate with password ({"email": "...", "password": "..."}) or with OTP ({"email": "...", "otp": "..."}). Sets access & refresh tokens.

item.name: Request OTP (login or password-reset)
item.description: Request an OTP code. Set purpose="login" for login OTP, or purpose="password_reset" for password reset OTP.

item.name: Reset password (public schema)
item.description: Consumes one password_reset OTP and changes the password. Django password validators apply.

item.name: Refresh access token (public schema)
item.description: Refresh tokens are bound to the schema and session. This request rotates the refresh token; use the returned refresh token for later refresh or logout calls.

request.description: Rotates the refresh token for this schema-bound session. Save the returned access and refresh tokens.

item.name: Logout / revoke current session (public schema)
item.description: Revokes this schema-local server-side session. Requires its active access token. The refresh token is optional, but if provided it must be the current rotated token for this session.

request.description: Requires the active access token. Optionally sends the current refresh token; revocation is enforced against the server-side session.

item.name: 04 - Packages
item.description: Care pricing packages linking to catalog entities (PackageViewSet).

item.name: List packages
item.description: List care packages filtered by package_type and period.

item.name: Create package (Service target)
item.description: Package linked to a catalog.Service. Enforced exactly one target.

item.name: Create package (Venue target)
item.description: Package linked to a catalog.Venue.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Deluxe Recovery Suite (Weekly)",
  "package_type": "IN_HOUSE",
  "period": "WEEKLY",
  "price": "18000.00",
  "venue": "{{venueId}}",
  "description": "7-day inpatient recovery stay with amenities."
}

item.name: Create package (Resource target)
item.description: Package linked to a catalog.Resource (equipment rental).

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Oxygen Concentrator Rental (Monthly)",
  "package_type": "CLIENT_SIDE",
  "period": "MONTHLY",
  "price": "6000.00",
  "resource": "{{resourceId}}",
  "description": "30-day home respiratory equipment rental."
}

item.name: 03 - TENANT OWNER PORTAL (platform schema)
item.description: Tenant owners edit and activate their tenant profile here. Authenticate with the owner account in the public/platform schema; omit X-Tenant.

item.name: List my tenants
item.description: Uses a platform-schema tenant-owner token; omit X-Tenant.

item.name: Get my tenant
item.description: Retrieve one owned tenant. Uses a platform-schema tenant-owner token; omit X-Tenant.

item.name: Update my tenant profile
item.description: Update tenant profile fields (supports application/json or multipart/form-data for logo file uploads).

item.name: Activate my tenant
item.description: Owner can activate only a provisioning tenant after required profile fields are complete. Uses a platform-schema tenant-owner token; omit X-Tenant.
